body:
This task involves generating ALFWorld text actions to accomplish a specific goal, requiring the agent to understand and execute instructions within a simulated offline planning environment. The agent must interpret complex prompts involving object manipulation, spatial reasoning, and potentially iterative problem-solving. Success hinges on accurately translating human intent into discrete actions that effectively achieve the desired outcome – completing the task – in ALFWorld.  The agent must demonstrate reasoning skills related to spatial relationships, tool usage, and potentially follow-up instructions within the ALFWorld environment.

The skill will be structured around a ‘sequence of actions’ approach. Each section will detail the core action and its associated context. The goal is to create a reusable module for generating ALFWorld text actions, prioritizing clarity and conciseness.  The agent should generate actions that are logically connected to the overall objective.
